summary: Startup and storage improvements for your private agent.

improvements: Startup reuses the same verified recovery resources.
Encrypted storage reuses connections without caching private information.
Chat preparation keeps cloud key retrieval off the request loop.
fixes: Mail notification progress survives retries without skipping unprocessed changes.
Software updates retain recovery authority when a cloud operation has an uncertain result.
Existing hosting choices remain unchanged when new setup defaults evolve.
security: Files analysis remains opt-in and uses the approved provider boundary.
Existing pods require a qualified image transition and exact owner approval before installation.
Computer Use remains disabled until its cloud isolation gates pass.
